data.one_liner: Verifies actual internet connectivity by checking reachability against global endpoints.
data.what_it_does: Proactively tests real internet access instead of local network statuses, providing subsecond verification responses. Features a stream-based API for real-time connectivity status updates and supports custom endpoints.
use_when: You need to verify true internet reachability rather than just local Wi-Fi or cellular status.
You want real-time stream notifications when the internet connection is lost or restored.
avoid_when: You only need local network interface or hardware connection status checks (use connectivity_plus instead).
strengths: Accurately verifies real internet reachability against global endpoints.
Provides a real-time stream-based API for status updates.
Universal compatibility with both pure Dart and Flutter across multiple platforms.
weaknesses: Active network checking consumes data and battery compared to passive network event listeners.
Requires proper cleanup of custom instances or subscriptions to avoid memory leaks.
data.setup_notes: Ensure network permissions are enabled for your target platforms in Flutter applications.

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need to check the local device connection state (Wi-Fi, mobile, none) without active HTTP ping requests.
